explication: EarTrumpet is a Windows system-tray audio mixer: users inspect per-app and device audio, adjust levels or routing, and manage defaults. The runtime centers on a Windows audio model feeding the flyout and device UI; a separate Actions addon provides configurable event-triggered automation. Settings, themes, and addon hosting support the experience. The map relies on README capabilities and the supplied source index and excerpts; unsampled implementation links are omitted where their caller is not shown.
